name: skill-publishing-filter
description: Meta-skill that decides how to package agent knowledge and whether a skill is safe to publish. Hybrid invocation — activates on context match or when the LLM identifies relevance at any point. Use when creating or modifying a skill, generalizing device-specific instructions, preparing a skill for a public collection, or choosing skill vs AGENTS.md vs MCP vs existing skill. Do NOT use for ordinary application code changes unrelated to agent skills.

locked: Never publish device-specific private machine state
Ask user before commit/push to public arsenal
